result.reason: The addition reaches the fallback position: it provides a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 90-day material-conformance warranty for the Site and deliverables, compliance with applicable laws, protection against viruses and malicious code, and re-performance, repair, replacement, or refund remedies. It leaves the existing representations and Globix provision unchanged. Drafting is generally professional, though “following acceptance” should identify the applicable acceptance event for each deliverable, and “the services and the Site will be performed and operated” is slightly awkward.
